analysis: AlphaFold per-region pLDDT for A0BFB4 (test for C-terminal ATG1 partner-binding domain)
model: AF-A0BFB4-F1-model_v6.pdb (AlphaFold DB, retrieved via prediction API)

regions.call: confidently folded, non-kinase element, no InterPro signature
short, partly disordered tail; NOT an ATG1 C-terminal (CTD/MIT) domain

conclusion: A0BFB4 has no C-terminal ATG1-type partner-binding domain; the only extra folded element is N-terminal and unannotated. This structurally corroborates Aslan et al. 2017 (PMID 28123910): ciliate Atg1-like kinases lack the Atg1-specific C-terminal domain, so ATG1-complex-dependent autophagy GO terms are over-annotations for A0BFB4.
